prose: Shopify plans to let Meta's personal AI agent, Muse, complete purchases on behalf of users at Shopify-powered stores, the Wall Street Journal reports. The purchases would run through Shop Pay, Shopify's one-tap checkout service.
highlights: Shopify plans agentic checkout via Meta's Muse.
Muse would complete purchases for users at Shopify-powered stores.
Transactions would flow through the Shop Pay one-tap checkout.
